recordingBinding.notes: Artist catalog and resolved public candidate agree on original single/date/Trident. Apple’s 7:11 compilation reissue is audio corroboration of the same performance, not exact 1968 lacquer identity. Retired linked Apple ID 400835962 returned no results; it is not identity proof.

independentSources.finding: Analyzes the first section as F major and the coda as a modal shift with unchanged tonal center; local secondary dominants do not redefine the global tonic.
Identifies the recording opening harmony as F, C, C7, F; supports F tonic, independent of the app charts.
Sony/ATV Piano/Vocal/Guitar edition MN0053747 lists original published key F major. It is an arrangement, not standalone recording proof.

officialAudioCorroboration.limits: Short official compilation-reissue preview; correlation is not probability or a standalone key oracle. Full bridge/coda not measured. Raw audio is not included.

verificationDecision: Convergent primary recording identity, independent musical analysis, and corroborating audio/publisher evidence establish the global F-major label at the performance level. No claim of exact mastering/mix bit identity, lyric gold or chord-placement gold.
